svg.title: A sphere with a slice missing
svg.text: 8 Bonus: a sphere with a slice missing
A cube changes outline as it spins. A sphere is always a circle, so it tumbles more smoothly.
a sphere: one video wrapped round
cut out an eighth: three flat faces
The three faces inside the notch meet at 90°, just like the ceiling and two walls: a tiny room corner, projected into the real one.
